svg.text: Is the line still in control? p-chart on the screening output
PCA reconstruction flags score >= 0.0217; one subgroup = 2,000 parts (one shift); Western Electric rules on frozen Phase I limits; modelled stream
A - process shift: true defect rate 1.5% -> 2.5% at subgroup 40
first alarm: subgroup 43 (4 of 5 beyond 1 sigma)
B - camera drift: brightness drifts 0 -> +0.02 from subgroup 40; true defect rate unchanged
first alarm: subgroup 44 (8 on one side of CL)
Panel B: the true defect rate never changes -- the chart alarms on camera drift alone. Full per-subgroup data: spc_chart.csv / SPC sheet.
